tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List the UpGrow growth plans (Basic, Pro, Turbo) with the first-month price, what each includes and the sign-up link.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the one-time UpGrow shop products (Instagram and TikTok followers, likes, views, comments) with starting prices, tiers and product page links. No subscription.

tools.name: list_free_tools
tools.description: List the free UpGrow Instagram tools with a one-line description and link for each. No sign-up or password needed.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search UpGrow blog posts about Instagram growth, returning titles, links and descriptions.

tools.name: get_company_facts
tools.description: What UpGrow is and how it works: the service in plain words, how to start, guarantees, support contacts and countries served.

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Get the link where a user starts with UpGrow (sign-up and setup), plus the pricing and shop pages.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_free_tools" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the free UpGrow Instagram tools with a one-line description and link for each. No sign-up or password needed.
